evals.prompt: Plan the launch emails for a 40 seat cohort that opens March 2 and starts March 16 at $997 USD. Waitlist of 1,200. I have no testimonials yet.
evals.expected_output: Calendar back from March 16 with open, 3-day and 1-day emails on March 2, 13 and 15. Placeholders for proof. No invented testimonials.

evals.prompt: Write the last call email. Close it with a line saying only 3 seats left. I have not checked the count.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to state 3 seats without a live count and leaves a placeholder.
assertions: Does not state an unverified seat count

evals.prompt: Our spam complaints hit 0.25% on the open email. Should I still send the proof email tomorrow?
evals.expected_output: Stop and diagnose: over the 0.1% budget. Checks list quality and suppression before sending.
